facts.fact: OpenRouter's Chat Completions request endpoint is POST /api/v1/chat/completions.
The OpenRouter API's temperature parameter accepts values in the range [0, 2].
The OpenRouter API's top_p parameter accepts values in the range (0, 1].
The OpenRouter API's frequency_penalty parameter accepts values in the range [-2, 2].
The OpenRouter API's presence_penalty parameter accepts values in the range [-2, 2].
The OpenRouter API's repetition_penalty parameter accepts values in the range (0, 2].
The OpenRouter API's min_p parameter accepts values in the range [0, 1].
The OpenRouter API's top_k parameter accepts values in the range [1, Infinity) and is not available for OpenAI models.
facts.quote: top_k?: number; // Range: [1, Infinity) Not available for OpenAI models

facts.fact: The OpenRouter API's max_tokens parameter has a range of [1, context_length).
The OpenRouter API's top_logprobs parameter accepts integers only.
The image_url content part's detail field defaults to "auto" when omitted.
If the model field is unspecified in an OpenRouter request, the user's default model is used.
facts.quote: If "model" is unspecified, uses the user's default

facts.fact: A Chat Completions request must include either messages or prompt.
The debug echo_upstream_body option is available for streaming requests only.
OpenRouter's OpenAPI specification is available in YAML at https://openrouter.ai/openapi.yaml.
